decisive_clauses.quote: Para entrenamientos costosos se aceptan resultados precalculados y versionados, siempre que el código que los genera esté incluido y documentado.
Reproducción independiente: una persona ajena al código ejecuta el libro desde cero en el contenedor y regenera la tabla principal de resultados; se reporta la discrepancia máxima observada.

A_B_C_taxonomy: Helpful project decomposition, not a universal guide demand to rerun C. The accepted scope must still meet clean-container book execution and principal-table regeneration by an external person.

requirements.requirement: Declare the immutable source/archive and exact principal result table to reproduce, with row keys, units and version.
requirements.pass_evidence: Source pin and generated table are explicitly connected to the result actually rendered by this book edition.

requirements.requirement: A person genuinely external to the code executes the procedure; identify relationship and actual execution.
requirements.pass_evidence: Operator-provided identity/relationship, date, commands, logs and own attestation. AI/CI-only receipts remain automatic.

requirements.requirement: Start from the delivered source, not cached HTML or preexisting generated output, and reconstruct the book inside the declared container.
requirements.pass_evidence: Fresh input/output directories, fixed image/digest or reproducible Docker build, clean book build with exit status.

requirements.requirement: Regenerate the principal result table rather than copying a frozen CSV to output and declaring it regenerated.
requirements.pass_evidence: Executed generator consumes admitted/versioned lower-level inputs, emits the table, and the rebuilt book consumes that output.

requirements.requirement: Precomputed expensive-training results may be used if versioned and their generating code is included and documented.
requirements.pass_evidence: Hashes and provenance for precomputed predictions/checkpoints plus generating source and an explicit statement that training was not repeated.

requirements.requirement: Provide fixed software/hardware, seeds, determinism settings, hyperparameter ranges, number of runs, dispersion and computation/energy scope.
requirements.pass_evidence: Environment and experiment metadata; unavailable energy or exact historical hardware is explicitly scoped rather than invented.

requirements.requirement: Provide the data or exact acquisition instructions and verified license scope.
requirements.pass_evidence: Per-input URL/source, byte size/hash, redistribution basis or exclusion; locator-only payloads are not counted as archived bytes.

requirements.requirement: Compare regenerated results to published references and report maximum observed discrepancy.
requirements.pass_evidence: All declared rows/identifiers are aligned, finite values and absences checked, per-field/unit maximum and location/tolerance reported.

requirements.requirement: Keep report generation and dashboard linked to the experiment master.
requirements.pass_evidence: Table/master provenance and consistency test; do not silently replace a current main table by a smaller historical table.

requirements.requirement: The book builds without errors and retains working citations/cross-references and documented tables/figures.
requirements.pass_evidence: Strict book build and link/resource verification from the clean generated output.

requirements.requirement: Attach the actual independent reproduction report and deployment smoke proof to the book.
requirements.pass_evidence: Executed external report and actual smoke receipt, distinguished from templates and software validation.

requirements.requirement: Keep signed authorship/contributions/AI declaration distinct from independent reproduction.
requirements.pass_evidence: Actual author-provided statement/signature; neither this checklist nor an AI agent manufactures one.
